caption: He only trusts a giving QR code if it can rapture.
alt: Single-panel comic in a church foyer. A folding table labeled 'PROPHECY UPDATE' holds a sign with a QR code that reads 'SCAN TO TITHE.' A dad holds up his phone while a volunteer gestures at the QR code. Speech bubbles: Dad says, 'Is the QR code pre-trib, or do I wait?' Volunteer says, 'Either way, the receipt is eternal.'
